premises.text: People have lost control of digital life history that storage keeps forever
premises.evidence_span: Storage is cheap, it is everywhere, and it is forever. We are all out of control

premises.text: Enterprise users such as clinicians need controlled messaging that would otherwise be illegal on ordinary apps
premises.evidence_span: if they were having this conversation today on Yammer, or almost any other site on the internet for that matter, it would be illegal

premises.text: Social Fortress protects data across enterprise, mobile, and consumer apps in real time without being a VPN or encryption gateway
premises.evidence_span: we are not a VPN. We are not a single sign-on. We are not Defector Authentication. We are not DRM. We are not MDM. And we are not an encryption gateway

premises.text: Protection follows messages and photos anywhere in the world on any device or platform
premises.evidence_span: brings Jason Bourne to all your messages, all your photos, anywhere in the world at any time

value.text: Regain control of data shared on everyday applications
value.evidence_span: They're in control of their data. That's the actual conversation

causal_links.evidence_span: relinquished real control of our digital life

notes: HIPAA-style enterprise illegality kept as a distinct problem warrant alongside general consumer loss of control. Negated competitor categories folded into the platform identity premise.
